description: Land Acquisition - Order to acquire the lands in Niwithigala, Rathnapura, Bulathsinhala and Seethawaka D/S Divisions
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, extents, boundaries, and survey references. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
